               Alan Elliott was the pilot of a Cessna 182 aeroplane
               which flew low over Goodison Park football stadium
               towing a banner.
                                                                                               Liverpool
ALAN ELLIOTT                                                                   04/04/2017                        Fine £2,000
                                                                                            Magistrates' Court
               Mr Elliott was convicted after trial of one offence of flying
               over a congested area at a height less than 1,000 feet
               above the highest obstacle within a radius of 600 metres.

                  Mr Hope pleaded guilty to flying within the RA(T).
                  David Harbottle was the pilot of a Piper PA-E23
                  aeroplane. A NOTAM had been issued stating that there
                  was no Approach or Radar service at Coventry and the
                  Tower service was available on 118.175; this information
                  was also available on the Coventry ATIS.
                                                                                                  Coventry
DAVID HARBOTTLE   Mr Harbottle entered the ATZ and landed at Coventry            28/03/2018                        Fine £3,600
                                                                                              Magistrates' Court
                  without permission; he was using the wrong radio
                  frequency.

                  Mr Harbottle was convicted after trial of flying within the
